en: The liquid lava from Mayon Volcano cools into a solid igneous rock.
The water in the Puerto Princesa Underground River is a liquid solution containing dissolved minerals.
Jose Rizal used invisible milk ink that undergoes a chemical change when exposed to heat.
Solid ice from the Cordillera mountains melts into liquid water during the hot summer.
The feathers of the Philippine eagle are lightweight solids that trap air for insulation.
Fermenting sugarcane juice in Negros involves a chemical change that produces liquid alcohol.
The solid limestone formations of the Chocolate Hills in Bohol undergo physical weathering over time.
The sand at White Beach in Boracay is a solid mixture of silica and crushed shells.
The gas helium fills the giant balloons used during the Pamulinawen Festival in Laoag.
The abaca plant produces strong solid fibers used to weave durable Manila rope.
The rusting of iron anchors from the San Diego galleon is a chemical change.
The solid bamboo walls of a traditional Bahay Kubo act as thermal insulators against heat.
